fullPipelineGap.limitation: Component CI successes must not be combined into a claim that a current full API-to-engine-to-PG-to-gateway-to-MinIO/rclone pipeline or a live cloud/onprem migration ran successfully.

limitations: GitHub run headSha, mergeSha and checkout markers are recorded separately; PR merge-ref checkout can differ from PR head.

Cleanup is verified only from allowlisted deletion output; implicit cleanup or a green step alone is not claimed.
